definition: (PROBE — G-20b Phase-2 path-A validation; keeper stays pjm-83, no criterion gain.) PJM 84 online-gated deliverable reserve co-opt: pjm-83 keeper recipe VERBATIM + pjm_reserve_online_gated (zone-aggregate R <= rho*sum P, rho=1.0, idle capacity backs no spinning reserve — the genuine 'reserve prop. to online output' online-gate, dispatch._build_reserve_rows:1311-1319) + measured_ramp_capability (EIA-860 '10M' fast-start floor + CAMPD CEMS 1-h envelope ceiling reconciling FleetArrays.ramp10, feeding the keeper's pjm_reserve_supply_cap deliverable cap). RESULT: structurally-faithful NON-FIRE. Reserve dual = $0 in ALL 26,280 hours (all 3 years) — the published two-step ORDC requirement NEVER binds. C3c energy tail 0 h > $200 every year (identical to pjm-83; actual 6/18/59). Path A (LP-linear online-gate proxy) cannot thin supply to the requirement on the perfect-foresight LP. Path B (an online commitment binary / the P2 fa_p2 availability screen scoping the ~39 GW deliverable cap down to the ~10 GW online-deliverable slice) is required for the requirement to bind. Confirms the G-20 diagnosis: PJM scarcity is blocked on LP tightness (commitment posture), not on reserve structure/memory/ramp data.
